main_text.l: verò fidelium; 1.Tim.4.10. Illi obseruant vanitates mendaces, dum & idola, quæ nihil in mundo sunt (1.Cor.8.4.) superstitiosè colunt, & brachij carnis, verè σύνεσιν[?] τῇ ἐπινοίᾳ[?] nituntur: & derelinquunt misericordiam Dei. Hi autem verum Deū in spiritu & veritate adorant: Ioan.4.24. & lętantur roboratam esse Dei misericordiam super timentes eum, secundum altitudinem cœli super terram. Psal.103.11.
Quicunq; in creaturis potius quàm in Creatore confidunt, sibi ipsis & aliis, maximo utrorumq; malo, imponunt.

Plusquam sacrilega audacia est, si quis prudens & sciens: flagitiosa autem igno-rantia, si quis nescius, terminos divinæ τῆς συντάξίας[?] moveat, & ἀταξίαν[?], creaturis quæ soli Creatori competunt deferenté, introducat. Dementiæ etiam est, idolis vanissimis ea tribuere, quæ viuentis & omnipotentis Dei propria sunt: & lignū appellare Patrem; ac gloriam incorruptibilis Dei commutare formata imagine mortalis hominis, & volucrum, & quadrupedum, & reptili-um.Rom.1.23.

page.notes: Greek words in the first paragraph (after "verè") and in the second paragraph (after "divinæ", and the word after it) are uncertain; they are marked [?]. The printed "fibijpfis" is read as "sibi ipsis". Long s read as plain s throughout; "Psal" read from "Pfal". Running head and page number read from the header. The catchword and signature at the foot are only partly legible.
